description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'Notification' within the OpenCart admin system, responsible for fetching and updating notification data from an external service, and setting a cookie to track notification updates.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling admin notifications, fetching updates from external server, and updating cookies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks for notifications, fetches updates from remote server if not already notified, and sets a notification cookie.
